Open Help (?), then Change log to browse what's new and past improvements to the app.
A.W. Pink's The Attributes of God is now available in the Books library.
Charles Hodge's Systematic Theology (three volumes) is now available in the Books library.
Listen on a book: use Start from Here to play from the sentence on screen, or Beginning to restart from the top.
Save and restore my data now includes Daily Verse Hunt progress, which What's new notes you've already seen, and your other saved settings.
Bible Reader: highlight verses or chapters with colored markers. Find them also in the Highlights menu under Old Testament or New Testament.
Bible Reader passage tabs now include search: find text in the open passage and jump between matches.
Bible Reader: search the whole Bible from the toolbar. Matching words are highlighted.
Small visual tweaks: tab bars fade as you scroll, long book names pan in the reader, and slimmer prev/next on phones.
Spurgeon's Lectures to My Students is now available in the Books library.
Chapter view: tap verse numbers to pick a range, then Read to open a new Bible tab.
Improved scripture text formatting in the Bible reader, with clearer paragraph breaks.
Presentation sections in the slide-out are now under Table of Contents—expand a section to jump to subsections.
Sync across devices (BETA): link a phone and tablet with a short pairing code so bookmarks, highlights, and other saved data stay in sync—no account needed.
Bug fix: In the Bible passage picker, verse previews now update when you change chapter and show your full selected range when several verses are highlighted.
Bug fix: Entering a device sync code on iPhone Safari now works with autofill, paste, and the keyboard Go button.

The Biblical Counseling Scripture Reference now includes many more counseling topics and scripture passages from Jay Adams's topical worklist. See Copyright & Attribution for the required notice and a link to his New Testament and Proverbs.
Bug fix: Returning to a resource at the top of the page now restores with the menu at the top instead of the site title half cut off.

The Biblical Counseling Scripture Reference now starts with a table that maps common counseling terms to biblical topics. Search on that resource highlights the mapping and shows which biblical topic fits your term.

Memorize now offers Normal and Strict practice modes, with a short explanation when you choose. Word-mode choices use a steadier layout and six number options for chapter and verse blanks. Finishing or resuming the last round after mistakes now works correctly, including saved error counts.
Bug fix: M'Cheyne Listen now stays on the correct day when advancing to a chapter that also appears earlier in the plan (for example, Matthew 1 on day 172).
Memorize now has Recite mode: record a memorized passage and see word-by-word accuracy feedback.
Bug fix: Recite mode now recognizes “Song of Ascents” when speech-to-text hears “a sense.”
You can now use Listen to hear resources read aloud on Android, including in the browser. The Android app needs an update from the store for Listen to appear there.
Memorize practice Listen for non-ESV translations now uses the same device speech as profile Listen, including in the Android app when speech is available.
